body.title: Recovery in Alaska. All Boroughs & Census Areas.
paragraphs: Alaska is divided into boroughs and census areas rather than counties. Anchorage, Matanuska-Susitna, and Fairbanks North Star generate the highest volume of Alaska foreclosure surplus cases. Alaska primarily uses non-judicial foreclosure through a deed of trust, and trustee sale surplus funds are held by the trustee or paid into the Superior Court until claimed by the former owner.

The Alaska Unclaimed Property Program, administered by the state Department of Revenue, holds millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed Permanent Fund dividends, and other assets belonging to Alaska residents and former residents. RCG searches Alaska Superior Court records, trustee sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every Alaska client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Alaska. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
